$description: Claude theme — warm cream canvas + coral accent + serif editorial register.

accent.$description: Coral — the Anthropic warm coral, primary CTA fill.

highlight.$description: Companion warm amber — small inline highlights, badges.

ink.$description: Body ink on cream = same warm dark.

graphite.$description: Body strong — emphasized paragraphs, lead text.

paper.$description: Canvas — tinted cream, the brand-defining warm white.

paper-2.$description: Surface card — feature cards, content cards.

off-white.$description: On-dark text — cream-tinted white that echoes the canvas.

off-white-2.$description: On-dark soft — footer body text, secondary labels.

surface-dark.$description: Code editors, model showcase cards, footer.

surface-dark-soft.$description: Code block backgrounds inside dark cards.

surface-cream-strong.$description: Strongest cream — selected tabs, emphasized bands.

accent-teal.$description: Secondary product accent — status dots, terminal indicators.

status-current.$description: Status: in progress — alias of severity-medium.

status-next.$description: Status: not yet started — muted neutral.

font-family.$description: Editorial pairing — slab-serif display (Copernicus/EB Garamond) + humanist sans body (Inter). JetBrains Mono for code.

radius.$description: Claude uses 8px on CTAs/buttons, 12px on content cards, 16px on hero containers. card defaults to 12.
